svg.text: Large landscape database map generated from DBML. Solid = real FK, dashed = soft/inferred FK, amber = finance flow.
Finance flow: schedule/actual source tables toward canonical ledger/settlements

ak_payment_plans = planned schedule | ak_payments = actual collection | ak_expenses = actual expense | ak_financial_entries = canonical ledger. Double-count risk when source tables and ledger are summed together.
